protocol.holdout_empty_fallback: if no eligible heldout, reserve two eligible previously unused stations with lowest SHA256(id); eligibility is completeness only; fixed before GFS extraction or cold labels/errors
protocol.features: same 15 weather-only features as frozen minimum; no station identity or target inputs
protocol.selection: primary each-year MAE,cold MAE,point crossing misses and false alarms <= legacy; regional each-year macro site MAE,cold MAE and crossing misses,false alarms <= GFS; rank primary cold MAE then all MAE; fallback legacy
protocol.detector_policy: original artifact, probability threshold, mask and timing immutable; point crossings are separate diagnostics, never new alerts
protocol.heldout_site_policy: do not load heldout dataset in selection; evaluate all eligible heldout sites after choice; no switch afterwards
protocol.sample_policy: all spring nights retained; complete 14 observed hours for scoring/fitting; no interpolation or cold-only sampling
